يختفون (form VIII)
# يَخْتَفُونَ (yaḵtafūna) /jax.ta.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# يُخْتَفَوْنَ (yuḵtafawna) /jux.ta.faw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
